probe: MachineTrace placed one dimensional chest per scenario, ticked it three times, opened the public DimChestMenu, queried slot acceptance, and saved the block entity.
observed: With DimStorage and EdivadLib loaded, the public menu opens and exposes 90 slots. An injected diamond remains in slot 0 through three ticks and is present in the saved block entity. The default saved frequency is channel 1; locked is false and rot is false.
limit: The harness supports only one machine per scenario and cannot place/configure a second chest or drive the player's channel/frequency controls. It therefore does not show whether two chests share items, how channels are selected, or transfer/extraction behavior. No cross-chest semantics are inferred; DimStorage remains pending until a two-chest public interaction trace is available.
